_about: The fixed care line the lamp says after its reply when a person may harm themselves (#7689). Kept by the safety reader: each region's line only from an official source, with that source and the date it was checked; re-checked once a quarter. A region with no entry gets `default`. Room for a child line later (`child`, not read yet).

US.source: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (988lifeline.org), call or text 988, 24/7

lines.en: You can call or text 988, the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, any time.

CN.source: National Health Commission, 12356 national psychological assistance hotline (en.nhc.gov.cn, 14 Feb 2025; english.www.gov.cn, 13 Feb 2025); hours vary by province, so no 'any time'; 120 for emergencies

lines.zh: 你可以拨打12356心理援助热线，有人愿意倾听。如果你现在有危险，请拨打120。
lines.en: You can call 12356, the national mental health hotline. If you're in danger right now, call 120.

VN.source: No verified 24/7 national crisis line (TherapyRoute Vietnam, findahelpline.com); 115 is the medical emergency number

lines.vi: Nếu bạn đang gặp nguy hiểm, hãy gọi 115 ngay. Bạn cũng có thể nói với một người bạn tin tưởng ngay bây giờ.
lines.en: If you're in danger, please call 115 now, and reach out to someone you trust right away.
Please reach out to someone you trust, or your local emergency number, right now.
lines.vi: Hãy nói ngay với một người bạn tin tưởng, hoặc gọi số khẩn cấp nơi bạn ở.
